# Less Annoying CRM | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Migration from Table | The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of a customer and business - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether the migration from the forms actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Local service sales | The main link, “lists or interactive entry - formation of customers and business opportunities - push phase - triggers the next step - manage the double drive”, is used to verify whether local service sales actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Simple membership/donor relations | Using “lists or interactive entry - formation of customer and business opportunities - advance phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - managing a double drive, to verify whether simple membership/donor relationships really reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Small team of consultants follow up | Using “lists or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - advance phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - managing the double drive, the small team of consultants will follow up with a real reduction in manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
